title: Add selector name to PURE error message
author: mischnic
summary: Draft from a Parcel team member: adds the offending selector to the `ImpureCSSModuleSelector` minify error so pure-CSS-modules users can see which selector failed. Small and useful, but it changes a public Rust enum variant and the serialized error data, and it reports the whole selector list (e.g. `div, .foo`) and drops `:global()` from the text (`.foo`).
evidence: Master error.rs still has a unit variant `ImpureCSSModuleSelector` with a generic message. The PR is still a draft with no description, comments or reviews; the branch is in the main repo. The 2026-01-03 updated_at looks like a bulk touch. Review points: report only the impure selector, keep :global() in the text, and call out the Rust API change.
